items.summary: Maintain a three-site bounded pipeline: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Each remains parked/private pending verified execution ownership and launch-readiness evidence. The reusable readiness packet must define the site brief, template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, measurement plan, rollback point, and preview-only launch gate without adding telemetry or inventing unknowns. Exactly one next step: update the existing complicated.work owner-gap with dated execution-owner verification and its launch-readiness packet. Do not deploy, publish, change DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, or create duplicate work.
